payload.text: NEXT GLOBALFOLD, LESSONS.md candidates (11)-(15) of 2026-09-23, with todos 109, 120 and 126; check each against the classes LESSONS already holds. (11) A MUTANT THAT KILLS EVERY ARM PROBABLY BROKE THE FILE: 0116's F8 opened a double quote a single quote closed, all nine arms failed on a syntax error, and vc counted it a kill; a kill counts only when the mutant parses (bash -n) and the arm aimed at it is among the reds. (12) A TEST THAT PARSES A TABLE BY POSITION GOES VACUOUS WHEN A COLUMN ARRIVES: builtins.bats's @builtin arm matched no row from 9b8a5e7, when the group column arrived, until 0138, and a planted unimplemented row passed it. (13) A CLAIM VERIFIED IN A FIXTURE THAT CANNOT SHOW THE COUNTER-CASE: fullcycle.md's dry run 'writes no log' was driven with an unsealed stub build, and a sealed one writes a log (watchout 23's shape, arriving through a page audit). (14) intent wb clear <sender> marks EVERY live message from that sender handled, not only the ones answered; vc cleared cc's 14:07Z approval of 0116 and 0138 unread, and cc made the same slip once; before a clear, list the sender's live messages and answer each, and read the count the verb prints. (15) A targeted test run includes helpers.bats and contract.bats whatever the change: a source-scan arm exercises no command, so a selection by command misses it; vc approved 0123 v2 on six targeted files, 223 of 223, and the full suite then failed two helpers.bats scans (a raw sha256 binary, and a bare mv, the 2026-09-17 hang's shape). cc's lesson; vc's miss.
